summary.intent: Configure GSD workflow settings interactively, generate a behavioral developer profile from session analysis, then clean up and merge stale CLAUDE.md documentation files.
summary.outcome: GSD config updated (adaptive model, TDD on, deep code review, intel/graphify enabled), developer profile generated from 151 messages with 8 dimensions scored, .claude/claude.md merged into root CLAUDE.md with stale claims corrected, dead path in sync.md fixed, all pushed to a chore/ branch with PR.

repo: Playwright MCP is NOT configured for this project; only Puppeteer MCP is (registered in ~/.claude.json)
.release-please-manifest.json tracks independent per-package versions (root 0.38.5, web 0.41.0, fuse 0.5.3), not a unified version
Staging tags format changed from staging-v*-rc-N to staging-YYYYMMDD-release-N; deploy triggers on staging-*
Sharing, file versioning, and client-side search are fully implemented v1.0 features — no longer out of scope
Desktop virtual filesystem is FUSE on macOS/Linux but WinFsp on Windows
TEE is Phala in production but local Docker simulator in staging (changed in commit f270d843a)
.husky/commit-msg hook was clobbered by commit 0d37d710b and no longer runs commitlint locally; only PR-title CI enforces conventional commits
GSD restructured from .claude/get-shit-done/ to .claude/gsd-core/ — old paths are dead

code.finding: Referenced dead .claude/get-shit-done/ paths after GSD restructured to .claude/gsd-core/; fixed to point at valid locations

workflow: gsd-tools config-set performs safe merge — unrelated config keys are preserved when updating .planning/config.json

/gsd:profile-user generates evidence-backed behavioral profile across 8 dimensions; artifacts include USER-PROFILE.md, /gsd-dev-preferences skill, and CLAUDE.md section with idempotent markers for future refreshes
Profile artifact generation places CLAUDE.md at repo root by default, not .claude/CLAUDE.md — verify placement before committing
Global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md profile table is not auto-updated; user must opt in explicitly during artifact selection

friction: Changes from /gsd:config and /gsd:profile-user accumulated on main with no feature branch, requiring a retroactive chore/ branch before pushing
profile-user created root CLAUDE.md instead of updating .claude/CLAUDE.md, causing a placement ambiguity that needed manual resolution
The .husky/commit-msg hook is silently broken — no local commitlint enforcement, only CI catches format violations
open_items: Global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md still contains the older, lower-confidence profile table — user opted out of updating it during this session
Broken .husky/commit-msg hook (clobbered in 0d37d710b) — commitlint does not run locally, only on PRs via CI
.planning/config.json changes from /gsd:config are bundled in the chore/ PR — verify this is intentional vs. keeping config changes separate
